name: Villaescusa (Zamora, Spain)
description: Red field with a white cross offset towards the hoist and the lower edge, the upper fly quarter blue with a white twelve-pointed star.
history: The town council of Villaescusa, in session on 30 September 1999, approved the heraldic arms and municipal flag; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of a full white cross whose arms are at a third from the hoist and two thirds from the top, of a sixth of the width, cantoned red except the upper fly quarter which is blue with a white twelve-pointed star.

features.role: cross with its arms at a third of the hoist and two thirds of the height
twelve-pointed star on the blue quarter
